title: Realm gives its first discovery a purpose
thesis: A discovery feels rewarding when it visibly improves the neighborhood the player is building.
summary: Shelter comes earlier, research guidance follows the actual action, and new building cards appear as soon as a discovery finishes. The opening connects a first Well to a Cottage with room for more neighbors.

comparisons.title: Point to the choice the player can actually make
comparisons.caption: The same player-built paused save in separate immutable worktrees, at identical camera, viewport and world-state hash. Before, Open Research highlighted the Founder. After, Research is highlighted and the guidance connects the next discovery to the home already built.

before.alt: Before: the Research instruction incorrectly highlights Founder.

after.alt: After: Research is highlighted, with the home established before the next discovery.

comparisons.title: Acknowledge the decision and explain the wait
comparisons.caption: The same Masonry choice, made through the real Research button in both revisions, with matching saved-world hashes. Before, the tutorial still asked to open Research. After, it reports research progress and explains that paused time must resume.

before.alt: Before: Masonry has started, but the tutorial still says Open Research and highlights Founder.

after.alt: After: the tutorial shows Masonry progress and a Resume time instruction.

changes.title: The first home comes before the first discovery
changes.body: The opening explains shelter, rest, neighbors and taxes. Construction progress remains visible, and paused time has an explicit next action.

changes.title: A discovery immediately changes the available choices
changes.body: The shell refreshes building cards when the researched set changes. Affordability updates follow the actual UI cadence, so skipped tick multiples cannot leave stale locks.

changes.title: Masonry pays off in the neighborhood
changes.body: Guidance connects a nearby Well and pantry food to a Cottage upgrade. Other first discoveries remain valid. The fourth building no longer dismisses an active tutorial before its payoff.

changes.title: Hover help clears when its card is replaced
changes.body: Selecting a desktop build card now clears its old tooltip, keeping it from lingering over the world.

builderNote.quote: The strongest moment was a home improving and another named resident moving in.
builderNote.context: Playtest observation from this pass, not an owner endorsement. The original Peaceful Valley opening was played through Day 5. This candidate has not been deployed. Focused checks cover opening/research, desktop and touch input, military guidance, save continuity and shell isolation. A single replay is not a balance benchmark. Early happiness advice and placement readability remain follow-up work.
